title: Reject duplicate JSON members
invariant: An exact duplicate member in a security-bearing JSON object must be rejected rather than resolved by last-write-wins parsing.

title: Require exact JSON member spelling
invariant: Case-folded aliases must not satisfy an exact security vocabulary or coexist as a decoy beside the exact member.

title: Reject trailing JSON documents
invariant: A parser must consume exactly one complete security-bearing JSON value plus optional whitespace.

title: Reconcile response bytes with physical outcome
invariant: Success-shaped response content must not authorize success when the physical invocation outcome or error code contradicts it.

title: Withhold positives when the authenticated producer is missing
invariant: A dependent positive fact is unknown unless its required producer exists and is authenticated.

title: Bind verified context to the required run
invariant: Cryptographic/structural validity alone is insufficient; the verified context must be associated with the exact required run.

title: Do not promote caller assertions into observed security facts
invariant: A caller-authored assertion cannot substitute for the required authenticated observation.

title: Require coherent cleanup and residue evidence
invariant: Destructive cleanup is complete only when deletion and residue observations are both present and mutually coherent.

title: Fail when a required security test disappears
invariant: A previously required security test must not silently disappear from the discovered test universe.

title: Require trusted execution evidence
invariant: Candidate-authored run/pass claims cannot prove that required test bodies actually executed and passed.
